# Northstone Kitchen Architecture

> An architecture-led kitchen design and remodeling practice in Scottsdale, Arizona.
> Founded 2003. Accepts fourteen residential projects per year. All architectural
> drafting, cabinetry milling and construction are performed in-house.

## Entity facts

- **Legal/trading name:** Northstone Kitchen Architecture
- **Category:** Kitchen remodeling contractor; residential architecture practice
- **Founded:** 2003
- **Location:** 7180 E Main Street, Suite 204, Scottsdale, AZ 85251, USA
- **Phone:** (480) 555-0142
- **Email:** studio@northstone.example
- **License:** Arizona ROC #331402, bonded and insured
- **Credentials:** NKBA Certified Kitchen Designers; AIA affiliate
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 08:30–17:30; site visits by appointment including Saturdays
- **Rating:** 4.9 / 5 from 127 Google reviews *(sample data in this demo build)*
- **Capacity:** 14 projects per year
- **Warranty:** 10-year workmanship; lifetime on cabinet boxes and joinery

## Service areas

Scottsdale (Old Town, McCormick Ranch, Gainey Ranch, DC Ranch, Silverleaf, Troon North);
Paradise Valley (Mummy Mountain, Camelback corridor, Clearwater Hills); Arcadia and
North Phoenix (Arcadia Proper, Arcadia Lite, Biltmore, North Central); Cave Creek;
Carefree; Fountain Hills. Occasionally Sedona and Prescott.

## Services

- **Full kitchen remodeling** — structural change, permits, services, construction
- **Custom cabinetry** — milled in-house in north Scottsdale, $1,200–$2,400 per linear foot
- **Countertops and stone** — quartzite, marble, porcelain, engineered quartz; slab selected in person
- **Kitchen design and architecture** — measured drawings, elevations, structural coordination

## Key figures

- Full architectural kitchen remodel: **$85,000 – $250,000**
- Renovation, same footprint: **$45,000 – $95,000**
- End-to-end timeline: **5 – 7 months**
- Design and drawings: 6 – 10 weeks · Cabinetry milling: 10 – 14 weeks · On site: 8 – 12 weeks
- Typical kitchen uses 28 – 42 linear feet of cabinetry
- Countertop cost installed: quartzite $120–$200/sq ft; marble $100–$250; porcelain $95–$160;
  engineered quartz $80–$140
- Financing: 0% APR for 18 months (OAC, typically 700+ score); fixed 60–144 months from 6.99% (660+)

## Frequently asked questions

**How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Scottsdale?**
A full architectural kitchen remodel in Scottsdale and Paradise Valley typically runs $85,000
to $250,000, driven by whether structure moves, whether cabinetry is custom or modified stock,
and the stone selected. A written investment range is provided free at the first consultation.

**How long does a kitchen remodel take?**
Five to seven months end to end: 6–10 weeks design, 10–14 weeks cabinetry milling, 8–12 weeks
on site. Northstone runs cabinetry milling alongside design approval, removing about a month.

**What is the difference between kitchen remodeling and kitchen renovation?**
Renovation restores what exists — new doors, new counters, same footprint. Remodeling changes
the plan itself: walls move, the work triangle is redrawn, storage is rebuilt.

**Do I need an architect for a kitchen remodel?**
Yes, whenever walls, rooflines, structural beams or window openings change. Northstone includes
architectural drafting in every project rather than subcontracting it.

**What is the best countertop material for a kitchen?**
For most Arizona kitchens, quartzite gives the best balance — marble-like depth with far better
resistance to citrus etching and heat. Marble for patina, porcelain for the largest runs,
engineered quartz for lowest maintenance.

**Can you remodel a kitchen without moving walls?**
Yes; about a third of Northstone projects keep the existing footprint.

**Will I be able to use my kitchen during construction?**
Not the room itself, but a temporary kitchen with refrigerator, microwave and a working sink is
set up in an adjacent space on day one at no charge.
